# Bottom sheet (`bottom-sheet`)

Sheet on phones, centred panel on wide screens.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createBottomSheet` (types in `dist/web/overlays/bottomSheet.d.ts`): `.mh-overlay.mh-sheet`: a modal sheet that rises from the bottom edge on phones (drag handle, swipe down to close,safe-area padding) and becomes a centred panel on wide screens. Parts: `__panel`, `__handle`, `__header`,`__title`, `__description`, `__close`, `__body`, `__footer`.

```ts
export function createBottomSheet(options: BottomSheetOptions = {}): BottomSheetHandle;

export interface BottomSheetOptions extends OverlayBaseOptions {
  description?: string;
  /** Drag the handle or header down to close (phones; needs `dismissible`). Default true. */
  swipeToClose?: boolean;
}

export type BottomSheetHandle = OverlayHandle;

export interface OverlayBaseOptions {
  /** Visible title; also the accessible name. */
  title?: string;
  /** Accessible name when there's no visible title. */
  label?: string;
  /** A close button in the header. Default true. */
  closeButton?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the close button. Default "Close". */
  closeLabel?: string;
  /** Escape and a scrim click close it. Default true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default `document.body`). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** Body content. */
  content?: Child | Child[];
  /** Footer content (usually buttons); the footer is hidden when empty. */
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** Called on every close, with what closed it (`'api'` for `close()`). */
  onClose?: (reason: OverlayCloseReason) => void;
  onOpen?: () => void;
}

export interface OverlayHandle {
  /** The `<dialog>` root. */
  el: HTMLDialogElement;
  panel: HTMLElement;
  body: HTMLElement;
  footer: HTMLElement;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setContent(...children: Child[]): void;
  setFooter(...children: Child[]): void;
  /** Closes immediately and detaches. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createBottomSheet, createButton, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' });

const pick = (scene: string) => () => {
  status.textContent = `${scene} is on`;
  sheet.close();
};

const sheet = createBottomSheet({
  title: 'Quick scenes',
  description: 'Living room',
  content: h('p', {}, 'Pick a scene for the whole room.'),
  footer: [
    createButton({ label: 'Reading', variant: 'secondary', onClick: pick('Reading') }).el,
    createButton({ label: 'Film night', onClick: pick('Film night') }).el,
  ],
});

const open = createButton({ label: 'Scenes', icon: 'lightbulb-on', onClick: () => sheet.open() });

document.body.append(open.el, status);
```

export function BottomSheet({ swipeToClose = true, ...props }: BottomSheetProps);

export interface BottomSheetProps extends OverlayProps {
  swipeToClose?: boolean;
}

export interface OverlayProps {
  open: boolean;
  /** The user closed it (Escape, scrim, close button, swipe); set `open` to false. Not called when `open` turns false. */
  onClose: (reason: OverlayCloseReason) => void;
  title?: string;

  label?: string;

}

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { BottomSheet, Button } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function BottomSheetExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const pick = (scene: string) => () => {
    setStatus(`${scene} is on`);
    setOpen(false);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="lightbulb-on" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Scenes
      </Button>
      <p aria-live="polite">{status}</p>
      <BottomSheet
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="Quick scenes"
        description="Living room"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={pick('Reading')}>
              Reading
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={pick('Film night')}>Film night</Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p>Pick a scene for the whole room.</p>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
}
```
